title: A Woman of Roses
overview: Amidst the rugged beauty of Oman’s Jabal Akhdar mountains, Fatima inherits her late husband’s small rose farm. Against the weight of tradition and the unforgiving terrain, she becomes the first woman in her region to cultivate roses, Navigating loss, isolation, and societal expectations, Fatima carves out a life defined not by circumstance but by choice, embodying independence in its purest form.
